summary: Phase-1 feature batch tested end-to-end. Backend: 45/45 pytest tests pass (19 new phase-1 tests + 26 existing regression tests). Verified sort=newest/price_asc/price_desc, available_only filter, favorites toggle+list, reviews (rating 1-5 validation, duplicate 400, average computation), KYC submit->pending->auto-verified after 5s, /auth/me exposes kyc_status, and Property.landlord_verified reflects landlord KYC state. All prior endpoints (auth/properties/bookings) still work — no regressions. Frontend: Home tab shows sort chips (Newest / Price low / Price high) + Available-only chip horizontally scrollable and switching sort actually re-orders the list (Price ASC top=₹7,500, Price DESC top=₹55,000). Heart button on PropertyCard toggles favorite; Profile > Saved Properties navigates to /favorites and shows the favorited items. Property detail displays share + heart buttons top-right, Reviews section renders average/count/list, Write Review modal opens with 5 tappable stars + comment + Post Review. Landlord profile shows the 'Get Verified' row under Verification section as expected. Demo tenant profile currently shows a green 'Verified' badge next to the Tenant role — the verified-state UI is confirmed working. Deprecated packages detected: none. React Native Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) still emit — non-blocking.

issues: React Native Web console warnings persist: 'shadow*' style props (migrate to boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents' (move to style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: (Optional/Data-hygiene) Demo tenant (tenant@nestfinder.app) currently has kyc_status='verified' persisted from prior test sessions. seed_data() short-circuits when users exist, so demo accounts are never reset. Consider adding an idempotent step at startup that force-resets kyc_status/favorites/reviews on the two demo accounts so KYC/Reviews demo flows can be exercised repeatedly.
(Optional) Replace deprecated 'shadow*' style props with 'boxShadow' and move 'pointerEvents' prop into style to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.

(Optional) The Review modal renders slightly below the visible viewport on 390x844 devices (Playwright reported star elements 'outside of the viewport' when using scroll_into_view). Modal content is present and testIDs match — consider centering the modal card with justifyContent so all star buttons and Post Review are visible without needing an internal ScrollView.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `import asyncio` is placed mid-file at line 650; move to top-level imports for cleanliness.
server.py has grown to ~680 lines; still acceptable but favourites/reviews/kyc are new logical modules that could be split into routers.
Favorites/Reviews responses correctly exclude MongoDB _id via projection.
KYC auto-approve uses asyncio.create_task on a per-request event loop — fine for single-process demo, but note the 5s task is lost on server restart (a legitimate demo trade-off).
GET /reviews/{pid} is public (no auth) — consistent with viewing reviews before booking; POST correctly requires auth.
landlord_verified is computed on the fly via _enrich_verified — correct and avoids stale data.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (test isolation fix: TestBookings.test_create_booking now filters to demo-landlord's property)
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed users/reviews/favorites/properties. Properties created in test_landlord_verified_reflects_on_properties are deleted at teardown. TEST_ users, reviews, favorites remain in DB (harmless, prefixed for identification).

NOTE: demo tenant kyc_status is already 'verified' from prior UI test — if you need to test the 'Get Verified' row for tenant, use the landlord account (still shows Get Verified row) or a freshly registered user.
rca_of_issue: No product bugs found. Two pre-existing regression tests (test_bookings_landlord, test_patch_accept_as_landlord) failed once because they relied on `arr[0]` being owned by the demo landlord. With the newly added phase-1 tests running earlier and creating landlord-owned properties in the same DB, sorting by 'newest' would surface those newer properties first. Fixed test_create_booking to explicitly select a property whose landlord_id == 'user_demo_landlord' with status='available'. All 45 tests now pass reliably.
